set.stimulus:
Ten persons sit in two parallel rows of five persons each, with equal distance between adjacent persons. Persons in Row 1 face south and persons in Row 2 face north, so each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2. The persons are S, T, U, V, W, B, C, D, E and F, not necessarily in the same order. 5. W sits to the immediate right of U.
6. S is an immediate neighbour of T.
7. Only one person sits between W and E when counted from the left of W.
8. Only one person sits between F and C.
9. B sits to the immediate left of F.
